# tree-sitter-html queries

The HTML grammar and its highlight query come from the npm package
`tree-sitter-html` (pinned in `package.json`). Only `injections.scm` lives
here: it is `queries/injections.scm` of tree-sitter-html 0.23.2
(https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-html, tag `v0.23.2`) without the
`<style>` pattern (see the comment at the top of the file).

License: MIT (`LICENSE`, copied from the package).
